rules.interaction: Would have needed a state exemption from the M.G.L. c.40P bar on local rent control; not enacted.
rules.title: H.3744: special law authorizing Boston to implement rent stabilization and tenant eviction protections
rules.requirement: A 2023-2024 bill that would have authorized Boston to adopt rent stabilization and eviction protections. It was sent to a study order and did not become law.
rules.key_value: authorization for local rent stabilization (no cap stated)
rules.quoted_span: An Act petition for a special law authorizing the city of Boston to implement rent stabilization and tenant eviction protections

notes: Bill history ends 9/9/2024 with 'Accompanied a study order' (H5035) in the 193rd session (2023-2024); no enactment, so status failed (inference from session end, page has no explicit 'died' action). Page gives no bill text, so no cap; the 'eviction protections' part is not split into a separate just_cause record.
